scope: Independent offline procedure review only; no engines, queries, new statistics, rankings or scope
consistent_elements: Native-only outcomes and exact 90 prepared / 10 unaided color-pair accounting.
Whole prepared-pair bootstrap within frozen families, fixed family counts, pair-average scores and seed 16120261113 with 50000 replicates.
Conditional descriptive inference; no random-Chess population, rating or opponent-superiority assertion.
Unaided starts and correlated trajectories separate; no pooling into prepared interval.
Phase boundary/material sensitivity is descriptive only; original helper and unresolved boundaries retained.
Threshold sensitivity keeps stable ranges, bounds, secondary status and unresolved roots distinct.
Behavioral coding separates observations/context/mechanisms, correlated episodes, contrary successes and uncertain boundaries.
Final independent normalization/inference/coding/claim/provenance challenge and owner stopping point preserved.
Admitted mixed-budget overlay remains authoritative; no uniform-cell-rate claim is introduced.

findings.issue: Seed and replicate count do not alone fix exact results: family iteration order, pair order, draw sequence and percentile interpolation are not fixed in the procedure. It asks to document interpolation later, leaving a numerical choice open until result production.
findings.requested_correction: Specify before execution: families sorted by stable frozen family ID, pairs sorted by stable pair ID within each family, one Random(16120261113) instance, replicate-major/family-major draws with replacement retaining each family count, and an exact quantile rule such as linear interpolation at index (B-1)*p on sorted bootstrap scores. Record Python version and input hashes. State singleton-family bootstrap variation is zero and conditional intervals do not estimate between-family population uncertainty.

findings.issue: The numerical section reconciles every selected root only. Frozen v1 requires a disposition for every played decision. Selected-root reconciliation alone can omit screening-only or untested roots and make the coded denominator appear more complete than it is.
findings.requested_correction: Add an explicit all-played accounting check against native histories, with supplied prefixes context-only. Preserve evidence tier and disposition/uncertainty for screening-only and unselected roots. Reconcile selected final ledgers as a subset and report their coverage denominator separately; do not convert missing deeper evidence into no-error or supported primary causation.

limits: No methodological change to bootstrap target, thresholds, rules, coverage, engine execution or behavioral categories requested. Existing final deep-analysis work can continue. Resolve these two text/specification points before final quantitative freeze and independent challenge.
